Name: Rankhog
Tagline: Get customers from Reddit on autopilot
Description: Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? Rankhog warms up a new one, and you own it. Run it from the app, or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. 7 days free.

Name: Creavit Studio 4.0
Tagline: Screen recording, iPhone camera and cinematic demos for Mac
Description: Plan, record and turn your screen into a product story. Creavit Studio 4.0 brings QR-paired iPhone portrait capture, camera takes added after recording, Content Planner, Standard and Liquid MultiFocus, cinematic 3D MacBook and iPhone scenes, Smooth Scroll, Smooth Typing, your voice in another language, and Auto FX with your approval at every stage. Built for Mac. Also available on iPhone for recording and editing on the go.

Name: Webless Agents
Tagline: Agents you want to put in front of customers
Description: You wouldn’t put most website chatbots in front of a customer. Webless Agents are different: you describe the outcome you want in plain English, and Webless builds the agent on your published content, so it answers only from what you’ve said. You review every instruction and change anything before it goes live. Then it gets to work: answering questions, qualifying buyers, sending quotes, booking meetings and handing off to your team. For Product Hunt: 3 months of our highest plan, free.

Name: Wispim
Tagline: The teleprompter that follows your voice
Description: Wispim listens and follows the words you actually say. Pause, and it waits. Speed up, and it keeps up. The script floats over Instagram, TikTok or your camera while you record. iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows, and free in your browser.

Name: Resurf
Tagline: Personal Knowledge Base & Bookmark Manager for Mac
Description: A fully local personal context library for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Save notes, links, images, and documents. Hand off context to AI through MCP or the CLI on Mac.

Name: Do It For Them Wallpaper Maker
Tagline: Photo wallpapers for the people you do it for
Description: Turn your favorite photos into a taped collage for your phone, desktop, video calls, or social banners. Choose a layout, add your own words, and arrange the photos in your browser. Watermarked downloads are free. $5 buys five watermark-free exports, including ZIPs and 300 DPI print PDFs up to 4 × 6 feet.

Name: DeNotch
Tagline: Hide the MacBook notch and tame your menu bar
Description: DeNotch hides the MacBook notch behind a black bar that works on any wallpaper, dynamic and Aerial ones included, and never edits your files. It tidies your menu bar too: hide icons behind ⌄, put them where you want, and show apps only while they matter, like your VPN while it's connected. Beside the notch, a pill holds live widgets (CPU, battery, network, a timer, now playing, GitHub, AI usage limits) and a cat. Free during the beta, for macOS 26 and later.

Name: Yoroll
Tagline: Build playable stories without a game engine
Description: Yoroll lets anyone turn stories into playable, cinematic games without coding or a game engine. Start with a script, image, or video clip, then direct the scenes, add player choices, and create branching storylines with different outcomes. AI helps bring everything together into an interactive experience you can share. It's more like directing your own interactive movie than programming a game.

Name: Copy Haste
Tagline: Your clipboard, sorted into Text, Code, Links, Media & more
Description: Most clipboard managers give you one long list. Copy Haste sorts everything you copy into Text, Code, Links, Files, Media and Colors columns, so you find things by type instead of scrolling. Code is highlighted with on-device language detection, colors detect 20+ formats, links lose their trackers and passwords stay out. Files and Media are separated. Pin what you reuse and sync pins and settings across your Macs. Your history never leaves your Mac, and there is no account to create. macOS 26.

Name: Ulika
Tagline: Visual editor for sites built with Claude, Cursor, or Codex
Topics: Design Tools, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: AI can ship a React, Vite, or Next site in a weekend. Then marketing wants a headline change and opens a ticket. Ulika connects the site so anyone can edit copy and images on the page and publish, without touching code. Open beta, free to try at ulika.co.

Name: Pushback: Flight Tracker
Tagline: The flight tracker that knows which lounge you can use
Description: A flight tracker for iPhone and Android that knows the lounge your status and cards get you into, whether you’ll make your connection, and your seat in 3D. One board for every flight, and what you may be owed when it’s late. Free while we launch.

Name: oovi
Tagline: Your own team of AI on your desktop
Description: Hand oovi a job and a team of AI bots does it: a leader plans, a researcher digs, a writer drafts, a critic checks. Watch each bot work, and approve anything before it goes out. Free with your own AI key, or from $10/mo with credits that never expire.

Name: Daymaker
Tagline: Gifts so personal, your prospects take the meeting.
Description: Daymaker is known for coldcakes, that ends today. Daymaker is the tool that researches your prospects, finds out their interests, recommends a personalized gift, repackages it in your branding, and sends it to your prospect. Making sure you get your meeting. Want it done for you? We run the campaign and guarantee the meetings.

Name: Leapdeck
Tagline: Leap to any Mac Space from a key or your iPhone
Description: Control+arrow walks through every Space between here and there, and each full screen app is a Space of its own. Leapdeck goes straight to the one you want: press a key, click a number in the menu bar, or tap a tile on your iPhone. SIP stays on and there is no account. The Mac app is free, with every hotkey. Leapdeck Pro is one purchase, not a subscription, and adds widgets, Control Center, Siri and Shortcuts on the iPhone, and Space names, a Quick Switcher and more on the Mac.

Name: TeaserKit
Tagline: your coding agent directs your launch video
Description: TeaserKit is the director for your coding agent's videos. Installed in one line, it makes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents direct a launch video, ad or explainer from your repo or website: a concept, a house style, a human-made song cut to the beat and a quality check before the final render. Includes a local Studio app. One-time purchase.

Name: Mockreel
Tagline: your screen recording, but in a 3D phone. free, no signup
Description: ok so every time I launch an app I need one of those 3D phone videos, and every tool wants a download or a subscription. nope. built my own. you drop in a screen recording (or a screenshot, I don't judge), it shows up inside a 3D iPhone / MacBook / iPad / browser window, you pick a look, add a camera move, slap a headline on it, export MP4 up to 4K. runs in a browser tab. no upload, no signup, no watermark, no catch. it's free. go make your app look expensive.

Name: Slotify
Tagline: Schedule game nights without leaving Discord
Description: Slotify is a scheduling bot for Discord. Run /slotify, everyone marks when they're free from a personal link, and the best times show up live in your channel. Repeat polls weekly, remind who hasn't answered, and turn the winning time into a Discord event.

Name: MindPal MCP
Tagline: ChatGPT & Claude build AI tools your clients use
Description: Connect MindPal MCP to ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code or Cursor and ask in plain words: your assistant builds AI agents and workflows from your knowledge, publishes them as AI tools your clients, team and audience use by link, reads what they asked, and fixes the gaps. Free on every MindPal plan.

Name: COKIQ
Tagline: Cookie consent for Indian websites, with a DPDP Act profile
Topics: Android, Chrome Extensions, SaaS, Privacy, Developer Tools
Description: COKIQ is cookie consent for Indian websites. It scans every cookie, tag and pixel your pages load, holds trackers until a visitor chooses, and keeps dated consent records you can export. India DPDP Act banner profile, prices in INR (paid plans from ₹799/month) and a free plan for one site, no card. Passes choices to Google Consent Mode v2. EU/UK and US profiles too. Also: WordPress plugin, Chrome extension, GTM template, iOS/Android app and a public API.

Name: Perfstaq
Tagline: Are you a top 1% developer? Prove it in one command
Description: Anyone can claim 5 years of TypeScript. Perfstaq lets you prove it. One command reads your own git history and your Claude Code, Cursor and Codex sessions, on your laptop. Your code never leaves it. Then GitHub spot-checks your commits at random to prove they're really yours. You get your exact standing (Top 1%, 2%, 3%…), cards made to share, and a link any client can verify in 5 seconds. Free, with an open-source scanner.
